Method of Attack: Man-in-the-middle (MitM) attack exploiting insecure HTTP communication to intercept update requests and serve malware
Use of hardcoded password for encrypting customer reports allowing attackers to decrypt sensitive data
Attack Vector: Insecure HTTP communication for update requests
Hardcoded encryption password in application binary
Indicators of Compromise: Use of HTTP instead of HTTPS for update service
Malicious XML update file with altered version number and URL
